data.content_ref: inline:The proposed relation is 'contradiction,' but the target's own primary refuted-if condition concedes that if 'safe' is read broadly as 'attaches metadata that enables downstream deduplication,' the two positions become 'compatible' rather than contradictory—collapsing the dispute to terminology. A contradiction that the target itself shows dissolves into a terminological disagreement under a natural reading is not a SUBSTANTIVE contradiction as the connection problem requires ('a summary of the endpoints is not a relation' implies the relation must carry genuine structural force). The target names 'contradiction' but its own refutation condition demonstrates the relation is better described as 'compatible under broader definition,' undercutting the very kind it asserts.
